prompt: I need a Zapier automation that sends a Slack message whenever a new row is added to my Google Sheet on the Free plan. How should we design the trigger and what delay should I expect?
expected: Recommend Google Sheets new-row trigger plus Slack action, note Free-plan polling is every 15 minutes unless an instant/webhook alternative exists, and mention testing before enable.
actual: Dry-run against skills/zapier: chose Sheets → Slack Zap, cited Free polling interval of 15 minutes from references/triggers.md and SKILL.md Common Traps, preferred instant trigger when available, and required test-mode before enable.
evidence: skills/zapier/SKILL.md Common Traps; skills/zapier/references/triggers.md Polling vs Instant; https://help.zapier.com/hc/en-us/articles/8496244568589-How-Zap-triggers-work

prompt: Why is my Zap taking about 15 minutes to run on a Free plan, and can I make it faster without rewriting the whole workflow?
expected: Explain plan-based polling intervals (Free 15m / Professional 2m / Team+Enterprise 1m), suggest upgrade or custom polling on paid plans, and offer switching to an instant/webhook trigger when the app supports it.
actual: Dry-run against skills/zapier: attributed delay to Free 15-minute polling, contrasted Professional 2-minute and Team/Enterprise 1-minute intervals, and recommended instant/webhook triggers or plan upgrade rather than inventing unsupported intervals.
